PLAN into 8/6, structure-first: the multi-month structural bull is fully intact (SPY 20>50>200 bull-stack, only -0.2% off its high), so HOLD the structural SPY/SPMO core; but with breadth back below 60% and SPMO below its 50-day, STAND DOWN the measured index / broad-momentum beta add and do NOT re-stage it until breadth reclaims 60%, SPMO reclaims its 50-day (~150.7) and SPY holds above the 769.1 flip on a close; ROTATE toward XLY (this window's top relative-strength sector) and XLK, funded from Weakening financials/health (XLF/XLV) and now-Weakening XLI, keeping XLC/XLP/XLE/XLRE/XLU OUT; HOLD MSFT and do NOT chase the extended, still-tangled gap; and keep a MINIMAL event-insurance residual overnight into July NFP 8/7 8:30am ET, since the flip sits directly underfoot and the sizing model still reads elevated. Persistence by distinct COMPLETED daily bars: the de-risk theme ran ~15 (7/09->7/29); the risk-on reversal ran 5 completed up bars (7/29, 7/30, 7/31, 8/3, 8/4) and was interrupted by the 8/5 narrow down bar; the broad-participation leg above 60% lasted exactly 1 completed bar (8/4 at 62.16%) and reversed on the 8/5 close (50.99%), so the broadening was a one-bar event that has failed for now while the underlying bull-stack persists. Catalysts, nearest-first: whether 8/6 RECLAIMS broad breadth above 60% with SPMO back above its 50-day and SPY holding above the 769.1 flip (versus the narrow 8/5 down bar extending into the 765 put wall / through the flip), the direction of conditional vol (still elevated in the model even as VIX stays calm), the still-unverified official 7/29 FOMC statement/path (re-pull), then July NFP 8/7 8:30am ET and the BLS preliminary benchmark revision 8/28.
